title: tilia americana var. caroliniana
intro: Tilia americana var. caroliniana, commonly known as American Basswood, is a deciduous tree native to the eastern United States. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include relieving anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of American Basswood include acting as a mild anxiolytic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic, which contribute to its calming effects on the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenes, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
